company.title: Company Settings
company.subtitle: Manage your organization's core details, localization, and preferences.

branding.title: Branding
branding.logoHint: Square image, at least 256×256. Shown in the sidebar and on customer-facing documents.
branding.autosaveNote: Images are saved as soon as you upload them — the buttons at the bottom of this page do not apply to them.
branding.ownerOnly: Only Business Owners can change workspace branding.

localization.title: Localization
localization.subtitle: Regional formats for the organization.
localization.currencyHint: Used for prices, quotations and reports. Amounts already recorded are not converted — only the symbol they are shown with changes.
localization.timezoneHint: Decides which day an appointment or figure belongs to. The dashboard and the calendar both use it, so they always agree.
localization.dateFormatHint: Controls the order of day, month and year wherever dates are shown across the workspace.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Applies to everyone who has not chosen their own language, and to invitation emails — whose recipients have no account yet, so there is no personal preference to read.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.subtitle: Manage quotation workflow settings.
quotations.requireApprovalHint: If enabled, Staff quotations must be approved by a Business Owner before sending.

clientManagement.title: Client Management Settings
clientManagement.label: Label
clientManagement.editCategorySoon: Editing outcome categories is coming soon
clientManagement.deleteFieldGeneric: Are you sure you want to delete this field? This cannot be undone.
clientManagement.deleteFieldPrimaryEmail: This field is currently used as this workspace's primary email. Deleting it will stop quotation emails from being sent to clients until you set a new Primary Email field.
clientManagement.deleteFieldPrimaryName: This field is currently used as the client's display name. Deleting it will make new client records show as "Client" until you set a new Primary Name field.
clientManagement.deleteFieldStatus: This field is currently used for the client status report. Deleting it will remove the status breakdown from Reports until you set a new Status field.
clientManagement.deleteFieldAssignee: This field is currently used to track which staff member a client is assigned to. Deleting it will affect staff dashboard scoping until you set a new Assigned To field.

profile.title: My Profile
profile.profilePhotoHint: Square image, at least 256×256. JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or AVIF up to 8 MB.
profile.emailOwnerOnly: Only Business Owners can change their email address.
profile.languageHint: Changes the language of the interface for you only. It does not affect how dates, numbers or currency are formatted — those follow your workspace's regional settings.
profile.photosSubtitle: Your profile photo appears next to your name across the workspace.
profile.changePasswordSubtitle: Update the password used to sign in.
profile.passwordRequirements: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, and a number.

team.title: Team Members
team.subtitle: Manage your team, their roles, and pending invitations.
team.confirmCancelInvitation: Are you sure you want to cancel this invitation?

invite.title: Invite Team Member
invite.roleStaffOnly: Only STAFF role is supported for invitations at this time.
invite.warehouseHint: If assigned, this staff member will only be able to view and manage products in this specific warehouse.

deactivate.title: Deactivate team member?
deactivate.intro: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in. Their account and history are kept, not deleted.
deactivate.stillAssignedSuffix: . These stay assigned to them until you reassign them.
deactivate.residualAccess: If they are signed in right now, their session ends the next time the app reloads, and within an hour at the latest.

team.confirmReactivate: Restore access for {{name}}? They will be able to sign in again.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Manage connections to third-party services.
integrations.ownerOnlyNotice: Only Business Owners can connect or disconnect integrations.
integrations.confirmDisconnect: Are you sure you want to disconnect this integration?

googleCalendar.name: Google Calendar
googleCalendar.description: Sync your CRM appointments directly to your Google Calendar.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose what this workspace sends, to whom, and when.
notifications.emailSectionHint: In-app notifications are always on. These settings control which of them also send an email.
notifications.emailEnabledHint: Turn this off to keep every notification in-app only.
notifications.expiryEnabled: Expire quotations that are never answered
notifications.expiryEnabledHint: This changes quotation records on a schedule. Leave it off to expire quotations by hand.
notifications.ownerOnly: Only a Business Owner can change these settings.
notifications.followUpAfterExpiry: The follow-up must happen before expiry. Reduce the waiting period or extend the expiry window.

formBuilder.emptySection: Nothing here yet. Add a block, or move a field in.
formBuilder.unplacedBanner_one: {{count}} field isn't on the form yet. Move it into a section so it can be filled in.
formBuilder.unplacedBanner_other: {{count}} fields aren't on the form yet. Move them into a section so they can be filled in.
formBuilder.noVersionsYet: This form hasn't been published yet. Publish it to start a version history.
formBuilder.viewingVersion: Viewing version {{number}} — a frozen, read-only snapshot. Editing happens on the draft.
formBuilder.selectVersionToView: Select a version to view it.
formBuilder.conflict: This form was changed somewhere else, so your copy is out of date.
formBuilder.inspectorEmpty: Select a field or block to change its size, colour and labels.
formBuilder.maxWidthHelp: Optional. Narrows the field; it never grows past its column.
formBuilder.contrastWarning: This colour is hard to see on a {{theme}} background ({{ratio}}:1). Aim for 3:1 or higher.
formBuilder.imageAltHelp: Read aloud by screen readers. Leave blank if the image is decorative.
formBuilder.addFieldFailed: Couldn't add that field. Try again.
formBuilder.deleteFormMessage: "{{name}}" will be removed. This cannot be undone.
formBuilder.optionsHelp: Type an option and press Enter or comma to add it.
formBuilder.label: Label
formBuilder.fieldKeyHelp: The stable id this field's value is stored under. Set once when the field is created.
formBuilder.boundToClientField: This field is linked to a client record field — editing it here also updates how that field is stored.
